_note: A FICTIONAL example brand. Replace every value. The engine reads this file and never assumes anything not declared here.

rules: Established product and platform names stay in their original language.
Declare a digit convention and never mix systems in one composition.

colour._annotationRule: Must differ from primary and from any action colour, so an annotation can never be mistaken for interface.

sketch._note: Declare which scripts the sketch face actually supports. A handwritten note in an unsupported script silently falls back and stops being handwriting.

impactHook._constraint: Style-specific, not universal: at this size a hook column narrower than about 740 px cannot hold words longer than about five characters without breaking mid-word. Re-measure when any of size, weight, tracking or column changes.

watermark._variantRule: The variant follows the luminance of the MEDIA under the corner, which a light/dark theme mode cannot know.
watermark.inset: margin, or the top reserve where one exists

composition.subjectScale: 40-70% of canvas, bleeding off at least one edge
composition.textPanels: forbidden — contrast comes from a global grade over the image
composition.annotationRule: must identify something real, or is omitted
composition.effectCeiling: one primary creative skill per scene, optionally one supporting

archetypes._note: Optional. Named pre-composed layouts. The engine treats these as CANDIDATE INSTANCES of composition strategies, never as a lookup from content type to layout.
